_doc: Flow prompts for the boy's step demonstration clips (one clip per phase; each clip covers the listed step IDs, split later by export_clips.py via step_clips.json). Character locked as the Flow character 'Skillmotion Boy' (art/poses/boy/idle-start-frame.png). Step wording comes verbatim from the catalogue (textEn); prompts only add staging. Model Omni 1.2 Flash, 9:16, x1.
style: Camera: fixed, eye level, front view, full body always in frame, hands and every object clearly visible and never hidden. Plain warm off-white background (#F6F4EE), soft gentle lighting, soft floor shadow. He moves slowly and clearly, like a patient teacher demonstrating to a young learner: each stage is a distinct, deliberate movement followed by a short calm pause, so it is easy to watch and copy. Calm friendly smile. Keep his exact face, hair, sage-green hoodie, sky-blue trousers and white sneakers. No confetti, no particles, no text, no extra people, no extra objects beyond those named, no camera cuts or zoom.

scenes.table: Skillmotion Boy, the stylized 3D cartoon mascot from the attached character, sits upright on a simple light-wood chair at a small light-wood table, facing the camera, table at chest height so his hands and the table top are fully visible.
scenes.sink: Skillmotion Boy, the stylized 3D cartoon mascot from the attached character, stands at a simple white bathroom sink with a chrome tap, viewed from the front at a slight three-quarter angle so his hands, the tap and the basin are fully visible. A small white bar of soap on a dish and a small light-blue hand towel on a hook beside the sink.
scenes.teeth: Skillmotion Boy, the stylized 3D cartoon mascot from the attached character, stands at a simple white bathroom sink viewed from the front at a slight three-quarter angle so his face, mouth, hands and the basin are fully visible. A child's toothbrush with a light-blue handle, a small white toothpaste tube with a cap, and a plain cup stand on the sink edge.

clips.props: A plain clear glass cup half full of water stands on the table in front of him.
clips.action: He calmly turns his eyes and head down toward the cup and looks at it with interest for a moment, hands resting on the table, then gives a small friendly nod.

clips.props: A plain clear glass cup half full of water stands on the table in front of him.
clips.action: Stage 1: he slowly reaches one hand forward to the cup. Stage 2: he wraps his fingers around the cup and holds it firmly, the cup still resting on the table; pause.

clips.props: He is already holding a plain clear glass cup half full of water on the table.
clips.action: Stage 1: he lifts the cup straight up off the table, keeping it level. Stage 2: he brings the cup slowly toward his mouth. Stage 3: he gently places the rim of the cup on his lower lip; pause.

clips.props: He holds a plain clear glass cup of water with its rim resting on his lips.
clips.action: Stage 1: he tilts the cup slowly so a little water flows to his lips. Stage 2: he drinks a small sip. Stage 3: he lowers the tilt slightly and swallows, a visible gentle swallow in his throat; pause with a calm smile.

clips.props: He holds a plain clear glass cup of water at his lips.
clips.action: Stage 1: he returns the cup upright to its normal level position. Stage 2: he moves the cup away from his mouth. Stage 3: he lowers the cup slowly onto the table. Stage 4: he opens his fingers and lets go of the cup, hands resting on the table; pause.

clips.props: A small plain clear water bottle with its cap already removed stands on the table in front of him.
clips.action: He calmly turns his eyes and head down toward the bottle and looks at it with interest for a moment, hands resting on the table, then gives a small friendly nod.

clips.props: A small plain clear water bottle with its cap already removed stands on the table in front of him.
clips.action: Stage 1: he slowly reaches one hand forward to the bottle. Stage 2: he wraps his fingers around the middle of the bottle and holds it firmly, still on the table; pause.

clips.props: He is already holding a small plain clear open water bottle on the table.
clips.action: Stage 1: he lifts the bottle straight up off the table. Stage 2: he brings the bottle slowly toward his mouth. Stage 3: he places the opening of the bottle gently on his lips; pause.

clips.props: He holds a small plain clear open water bottle with its opening on his lips.
clips.action: Stage 1: he tilts the bottle slowly upward. Stage 2: he drinks a little water. Stage 3: he lowers the tilt and swallows, a visible gentle swallow; pause with a calm smile.

clips.props: He holds a small plain clear open water bottle at his lips.
clips.action: Stage 1: he returns the bottle upright to its normal position. Stage 2: he moves the bottle away from his mouth. Stage 3: he lowers the bottle slowly onto the table. Stage 4: he opens his fingers and lets go, hands resting on the table; pause.

clips.props: A plain clear cup of water with a light-blue drinking straw stands on the table in front of him.
clips.action: He calmly turns his eyes and head down toward the cup with the straw and looks at it with interest for a moment, hands resting on the table, then gives a small friendly nod.

clips.props: A plain clear cup of water with a light-blue drinking straw stands on the table in front of him.
clips.action: Stage 1: he slowly reaches one hand forward to the cup. Stage 2: he wraps his fingers around the cup and holds it steady on the table; pause.

clips.props: He holds a plain clear cup of water with a light-blue straw on the table.
clips.action: Stage 1: he lifts the cup a little and brings the straw close to his mouth. Stage 2: he places the tip of the straw between his lips. Stage 3: he closes his lips gently around the straw; pause.

clips.props: He holds a plain clear cup of water with a light-blue straw between his closed lips.
clips.action: Stage 1: he sucks gently and the water level rises visibly inside the straw. Stage 2: he swallows, a visible gentle swallow; pause with a calm smile.

clips.props: He holds a plain clear cup of water with a light-blue straw between his lips.
clips.action: Stage 1: he takes the straw out of his mouth. Stage 2: he moves his mouth back away from the straw. Stage 3: he lowers the cup slowly onto the table. Stage 4: he opens his fingers and lets go of the cup, hands resting on the table; pause.

clips.props: He starts standing one step back from the sink.
clips.action: Stage 1: he looks at the sink with interest. Stage 2: he walks calmly forward and stops in front of the sink, ready; pause.

clips.props: He stands at the sink; the tap is off.
clips.action: Stage 1: he turns the tap handle and a gentle stream of clear water flows. Stage 2: he puts both hands under the water and wets them fully, front and back; pause.

clips.props: He stands at the sink with wet hands; water still running gently.
clips.action: Stage 1: he picks up the white bar of soap from the dish. Stage 2: he rubs the soap between his hands so soft white lather appears, then puts the soap back on the dish; pause.

clips.props: He stands at the sink holding his soapy hands up in front of his chest so they are clearly visible.
clips.action: Stage 1: he rubs his palms together in slow circles. Stage 2: he interlaces his fingers and rubs between them. Stage 3: he rubs the back of each hand with the other palm and scrubs around his fingernails; each stage clearly separate.

clips.props: He stands at the sink with soapy hands; water running gently.
clips.action: Stage 1: he rinses his hands under the water until all the lather is gone. Stage 2: he turns the tap handle off and the water stops; pause.

clips.props: He stands at the sink with clean wet hands; tap off.
clips.action: Stage 1: he takes the light-blue hand towel from the hook. Stage 2: he dries his hands well, palms, backs and between the fingers, then hangs the towel back; pause with a calm smile.

clips.props: The toothbrush and toothpaste lie on the sink edge.
clips.action: Stage 1: he looks at the toothbrush and the toothpaste. Stage 2: he picks up the toothbrush in one hand and the toothpaste tube in the other; pause.

clips.props: He holds the toothbrush in one hand and the capped toothpaste tube in the other.
clips.action: Stage 1: he twists the cap off the toothpaste tube and sets the cap on the sink. Stage 2: he squeezes a small pea-sized dot of white toothpaste onto the bristles; pause and show the brush.

clips.props: He holds the toothbrush with a small dot of toothpaste.
clips.action: Stage 1: he holds the brush well with a firm, relaxed grip. Stage 2: he smiles wide showing his teeth and brushes the front teeth with small gentle circles; soft white foam.

clips.props: He is brushing his teeth with a light-blue toothbrush, a little white foam.
clips.action: Stage 1: he brushes the back teeth on each side. Stage 2: he brushes the inside surfaces of the teeth. Stage 3: he brushes the chewing surfaces with short back-and-forth strokes; each stage clearly separate.

clips.props: He is finishing brushing, a little white foam.
clips.action: Stage 1: he finishes brushing gently and takes the brush out. Stage 2: he leans over the basin and spits the toothpaste into the sink. Stage 3: he takes a sip of water from the plain cup, swishes, and spits the water into the sink; pause.

clips.props: He holds the used toothbrush; tap available.
clips.action: Stage 1: he rinses the toothbrush under the running tap and turns the tap off. Stage 2: he puts the toothbrush and the capped toothpaste back in their place on the sink edge; pause with a calm smile.
